```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,
                      error = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(rWCVPdata)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r loading data}
country_shapefiles<-wgsrpd3%>%
  st_set_crs(4326)

dat<-read_csv(here("data","Cotoneaster review output","Final gbif_records_090426.csv"))
```


```{r getting distances}
dist<-1000000 # 1 000 km

dat_nn<-
  dat%>%
  mutate(nativeness = case_when(is.na(nativeness) & nn_dist < dist ~ nn_nativeness,
                                is.na(nativeness) & nn_dist > dist ~ "nonnative",
                                TRUE ~ nativeness))%>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude","latitude"),crs = 4326)
```

## Supplementary plots

**Plotting each species**


```{r generating maps}
species_list<-dat_nn%>%
  group_by(wcvp_species)%>%
  summarise(n = length(wcvp_species))%>%
  arrange(-n)

results<-list()

for(i in 1:length(species_list$wcvp_species)){

  plot<-
    ggplot()+
    annotation_borders()+
    geom_sf(data = dat_nn %>% filter(wcvp_species == species_list$wcvp_species[i]),
            aes(colour = nativeness))+
    labs(title = paste("Cotoneaster",species_list$wcvp_species[i]))+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(legend.position = "inside",
          legend.position.inside = c(0.1,0.4))

  results[[i]]<-plot

}
```

```{r plotting maps}
results[1:140]
```
